#!/bin/sh
# 仅在无磁盘四核实验客体采样，保留计数与原始事件，不改变时钟或调度策略。
set -eu
root=/sys/kernel/tracing
instance=$root/instances/sshpool_guest_timers
output=/tmp/ssi-timer-capture
[ "$(uname -r)" = 6.8.0-147-generic ]
[ "$(hostname)" = sshpool-ssi-guest ]
[ "$(nproc)" = 4 ]
grep -qw 'rdinit=/init' /proc/cmdline
case "${1:-}" in
start)
    if ! grep -q ' /sys/kernel/tracing tracefs ' /proc/mounts; then
        mount -t tracefs tracefs "$root"
    fi
    [ -z "$(ls -A "$root/instances")" ]
    [ -z "$(cat "$root/kprobe_events")" ]
    mkdir "$output"
    mkdir "$instance"
    echo 0 > "$instance/tracing_on"
    echo global > "$instance/trace_clock"
    echo 8192 > "$instance/buffer_size_kb"
    cat /proc/cmdline > "$output/cmdline"
    cat /proc/version > "$output/version"
    cat /proc/sys/kernel/tainted > "$output/tainted"
    cat /proc/cpuinfo > "$output/cpuinfo"
    cat /sys/devices/system/clocksource/clocksource0/current_clocksource > "$output/clocksource"
    cat "$instance/trace_clock" > "$output/trace_clock"
    cat "$instance/buffer_size_kb" > "$output/buffer_size_kb"
    for event in timer/hrtimer_init timer/hrtimer_start timer/hrtimer_cancel timer/hrtimer_expire_entry timer/hrtimer_expire_exit sched/sched_switch sched/sched_waking sched/sched_wakeup workqueue/workqueue_execute_start workqueue/workqueue_execute_end irq_vectors/local_timer_entry irq_vectors/local_timer_exit; do
        name=${event##*/}
        cat "$instance/events/$event/format" > "$output/format-$name"
        case "$event" in
        sched/sched_switch) echo 'prev_comm == "ssi-clock" || next_comm == "ssi-clock"' > "$instance/events/$event/filter";;
        sched/sched_waking|sched/sched_wakeup) echo 'comm == "ssi-clock"' > "$instance/events/$event/filter";;
        esac
        cat "$instance/events/$event/filter" > "$output/filter-$name"
        echo 1 > "$instance/events/$event/enable"
    done
    cat /proc/kallsyms > "$output/kallsyms"
    for symbol in ktime_get_update_offsets_now tick_sched_do_timer tick_sched_handle; do
        extra=''
        echo "p:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_enter $symbol $extra" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        echo "r128:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_exit $symbol" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
    done
    for event in "$instance"/events/ssi_guest_irq/*; do
        [ -d "$event" ] || continue
        name=${event##*/}
        cat "$event/format" > "$output/format-$name"
        cat "$event/filter" > "$output/filter-$name"
    done
    cat "$root/kprobe_events" > "$output/probes"
    cat "$root/kprobe_profile" > "$output/profile-before"
    echo 1 > "$instance/tracing_on"
    echo 1 > "$instance/events/ssi_guest_irq/enable"
    echo guest_timer_begin > "$instance/trace_marker"
    echo GUEST_TIMER_TRACE_READY
    ;;
stop)
    [ -d "$output" ]
    [ -d "$instance" ]
    echo guest_timer_end > "$instance/trace_marker"
    echo 0 > "$instance/events/enable"
    echo 0 > "$instance/tracing_on"
    cat "$instance/trace" > "$output/trace"
    for cpu in "$instance"/per_cpu/cpu*; do
        cat "$cpu/stats" > "$output/stats-${cpu##*/}"
    done
    echo 0 > "$instance/events/enable"
    cat "$root/kprobe_profile" > "$output/profile-after"
    rmdir "$instance"
    [ ! -e "$instance" ]
    for symbol in ktime_get_update_offsets_now tick_sched_do_timer tick_sched_handle; do
        echo "-:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_enter" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
        echo "-:ssi_guest_irq/${symbol}_exit" >> "$root/kprobe_events"
    done
    [ -z "$(cat "$root/kprobe_events")" ]
    echo complete > "$output/cleanup"
    echo GUEST_TIMER_TRACE_STOPPED
    ;;
*) echo 'usage: guest-timer-trace.sh start|stop' >&2; exit 2;;
esac

import argparse
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import subprocess
import shlex
import threading
import select
import time

parser=argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument('--mode',choices=['control','pair'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--variant',choices=['baseline','adjust','sync'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--label',required=True)
parser.add_argument('--kernel',choices=['7.1.0-rc3-sshpool-gvm-pf29'],required=True)
parser.add_argument('--qemu')
parser.add_argument('--qemu-sha')
args=parser.parse_args()
if bool(args.qemu)!=bool(args.qemu_sha): raise SystemExit('both qemu and qemu-sha required')
root=Path('/Users/zjarlin/.sshpool/ssi-lab')
prefix=root/'evidence'/args.label
if Path(str(prefix)+'-result.json').exists():
    raise SystemExit('Refusing to overwrite prior run')
config=Path(__file__).parent/'guest_ssh_config'
base=['ssh','-F',str(config),'-o','BatchMode=yes','-o','ConnectTimeout=30','-o','ServerAliveInterval=15','-o','ServerAliveCountMax=3']
peers=[r['address'] for r in json.loads((Path(__file__).parent/'boot.json').read_text())]
nodes=range(2 if args.mode=='pair' else 1)
stop=threading.Event()
logs=[]
processes=[]
close_tracers=[]
results={'mode':args.mode,'variant':args.variant,'phases':{},'samples_errors':[]}
qemu_name='qemu-system-x86_64-clock-offset-1' if args.variant=='sync' else 'qemu-system-x86_64-unpin'
if args.qemu: qemu_name=args.qemu
expected_machines=['bed141ceb5a94840930beead90b4d3a8','97609053a4db470a8a9fd24d2d2af76b']
host_cursors={}
results['qemu']=qemu_name
results['qemu_sha256']=args.qemu_sha
started=time.monotonic()
def phase(name, command, timeout=180, stdin=None):
    captures=[]
    print(f'phase={name} start elapsed={time.monotonic()-started:.1f}',flush=True)
    begin=time.monotonic()
    with open(str(prefix)+'-'+name+'.log','wb') as out:
        try:
            result=subprocess.run(command,input=stdin,stdout=out,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=timeout)
            code=result.returncode
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            code=124
            out.write(b'\nHARNESS_TIMEOUT\n')
    phase_seconds=round(time.monotonic()-begin,3)
    for node,kind,tracer,err,remote_output in captures:
        tracer.stdin.write('stop\n');tracer.stdin.flush()
    for node,kind,tracer,err,remote_output in captures:
        status=tracer.wait(timeout=45);err.close()
        raw=subprocess.check_output(base+[f'ssi-lab-{node+1}','sudo cat '+remote_output],timeout=60)
        Path(f'{prefix}-node{node}-{kind}-trace.json').write_bytes(raw)
        if status:raise RuntimeError(f'trace node {node} kind {kind} exited {status}')
    results['phases'][name]={'exit':code,'seconds':phase_seconds}
